source.title: Ministry of Panchayati Raj — Local Government Directory (LGD), mirrored and normalized from dated source reports
source.note: Rows derive from Ministry of Panchayati Raj LGD reports collected and normalized by a community mirror. The directory codes and names originate in LGD, but this imported copy is not a direct Ministry-hosted export. Development blocks and sub-districts are separate LGD entity types; sub-districts may be tehsils, taluks, mandals or equivalent administrative units and are not necessarily identical to state-notified subdivisions.
